ideas.children_he: פְּרֵדָה מֵאָדָם אָהוּב מְבִיאָה עֶצֶב גָּדוֹל.
ideas.children_en: Sarah lived full lives in different stages. When she died in Hebron, Abraham came from Beersheba to mourn her.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם רָצָה מָקוֹם מְכֻבָּד לִקְבֻרַּת שָׂרָה.
ideas.children_en: Abraham spoke with Hebron leaders and said he lived there long. He asked to buy land to bury Sarah.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁמִּישֶׁהוּ אָבֵל, חָשׁוּב לְהִתְנַהֵג אֵלָיו בְּכָבוֹד.
ideas.children_en: The Hittites thought Abraham special and let him choose any grave he wanted, though he had no official rights.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָהָם רָצָה לִקְנוֹת מָקוֹם שֶׁיִּהְיֶה שַׁיָּךְ לְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Abraham did not want a regular place; he bought a special cave in Machpelah, paying full price to keep it for his family.

ideas.children_he: אֲנָשִׁים יְכוֹלִים לְנַהֵל מַשָּׂא וּמַתָּן בְּנִימוּס.
ideas.children_en: Ephron spoke publicly to Abraham and offered him the field and cave to bury Sarah, kindly and respectfully.

ideas.children_he: הֶסְכֵּם בָּרוּר וְתַשְׁלוּם הוֹגֵן מוֹנְעִים מַחֲלֹקוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Abraham bought the field with pure money, no haggling, because Ephron said price did not matter as they were close.

ideas.children_he: מְקוֹם קְבוּרָה יָכוֹל לְהִהָפֵךְ לְמָקוֹם זִכָּרוֹן לְדוֹרוֹת.
ideas.children_en: The field and cave became Abraham's property in front of all, and he buried Sarah there for her final rest.
